old_caption: The video begins with a close-up shot of a rectangular sponge placed on a white plate with a black rim. The sponge is yellow with a green base, indicating it's likely a kitchen sponge. A clear plastic bottle is positioned above the sponge, from which a dark liquid is being poured onto its surface. As the liquid is applied, it starts to bubble and foam, suggesting it might be a cleaning solution or a chemical reaction. The liquid spreads across the sponge, covering most of its surface area. Steam rises from the sponge, indicating that the liquid is hot or reacting at a high temperature. The background is blurred, focusing attention on the sponge and the pouring action. The video captures the transformation of the sponge as it absorbs the liquid, with the steam adding a dynamic element to the scene.

caption: A rectangular yellow kitchen sponge with a green scouring-pad base sits on a white plate trimmed with a black rim, set against a dark background. Its top surface is already coated in a thick, glossy, dark layer that bubbles and churns, while wisps of steam rise steadily from it. From the upper-right corner, a transparent container tilts to pour a thin stream of clear liquid onto the sponge. The stream first strikes the right portion of the dark coating, then shifts toward the center as the container moves. With each pour, the viscous layer spreads, thickens, and grows wetter, its bubbles enlarging and bursting across nearly the whole upper surface. A brownish pool of liquid gathers along the right edge of the sponge on the plate and slowly widens. The clear stream gradually thins and fades out. Yet the dark layer continues to bubble and the steam keeps rising.
